lines: The true feeling is “no think!”
Pretending not to notice?
An absolute blend of falsehood and truth within the heart
Thus the resting place dwindles
Selling cuts of wounds
Fragilely screaming, a disgrace
Recommended for you! A top‑grade escape
Soon, will those lured by the sweet trap be saved?
In this world, we can no longer survive by sane means
Is the best answer to deliberately act clueless and go with the flow?
Even a bouquet adorned with words—if it steals a heart, is it genuine?
You are invited to an event where everything seems to be dyed
Farewell!
A fragility crafted for this era, please watch it
Deceived by a real play, random and noisy heartbeats
Lives are quickly running out, durability wearing thin
Dodging the events before me, I’m just trying to survive!
Someone, help me
“You’ll get sleepier”—a shallow hypnosis
Head, body, wrapped in smoke—could it be countless deceptions!?
A trembling coin before me, the distance where it stops moving
“This is fine”—even I deceive myself and shut down
“You’ll get sleepier”—a shallow hypnosis
Head, body, wrapped in smoke—could it be countless deceptions!?
A trembling coin before me, the distance where it stops moving...
No matter how I get through today, everyday goes unrewarded
I’m now stuck in a bot‑like cycle, continuing moments of inertia
If there’s no luck or hope, it’s even more hopeless
What’s missing stays missing; resigning and battling with leftovers is destiny
A fragility crafted for this era, please watch it
Deceived by a real play, random and noisy heartbeats
Praise has become meaningless, a false charisma
Staring too directly at reality will blind you!
So, in moderation
